SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. 9400
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date August 25, 1939.

Subject Dinner Party Park Hotel by Sino-Polish Cultural Association

Made by / and Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

A private dinner party to be given by the
Sino-Polish Cultural Association will take place
in the Park Hotel at 8 p.m. August 25th, 1939.
The office of this body is located at Chungking
and a Mr. S.M. Lee (Professor ?) is the local
representative, the Polish Minister to China
being Honorary President.

Invitations were sent out four days ago
and were received by the Polish Consulate,
the R.S.V.P. to Mr. S.M. Lee, 384 Avenue Foch.

No information regarding number of guests
or their names is available but the Polish Minister,
Consul and two three members of the Polish Legation
and Consulate will attend. The Chinese guests
will include several persons connected with the
Chungking Government.

D.S.J. Rokofier
C 8/8.

C. Crawford
D. I.

A.C. (Special Branch).

报告
日期：1939年8月25日。

事由：中波文化协会在国际饭店举行的晚宴

由 D.I. Crawford 撰写并转呈

中波文化协会将于1939年8月25日晚8时在国际饭店（Park Hotel）举行私人晚宴。该机构办事处位于重庆，李S.M.先生（教授？）为本地代表，波兰驻华公使担任名誉会长。

请柬于四日前发出，波兰领事馆已收到，回复请寄至福煦路384号李S.M.先生处。

目前尚无关于宾客人数或姓名的信息，但波兰公使、领事以及波兰公使馆和领事馆的两三名成员将出席。中方宾客将包括数名与重庆政府有关联的人士。

D.S.J. Rokofier
C 8/8.

C. Crawford
D. I.

A.C.（特别分部）。

Date August 26, 1939

Subject Sino-Polish Cultural Association - farewell dinner party to Polish Minister.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford S.I.

（批：Z.P. Liu, Information, R.D. Yake, A.Y. 26/8.）

between 8 p.m. and 11 p.m. of August 25, 1939
a private dinner party was held in the Grill Room of the Park Hotel under the auspices of the Sino-Polish Cultural Association in honour of Mr. Georges Barthel de Weydenthal, Polish Envoy Extraordinary and Minister Plenipotentiary in China, who will leave for Poland shortly. About forty persons of both sexes were present including several members of the Polish Legation and Consulate and the following prominent Chinese representing educational and commercial circles:-

Dr. Chu Min-nyi (褚民誼) Member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang and President of the Institut Technique Franco-Chinois, 1195 Rue Lafayette; brother-in-law of Mr. Wang Ching-wei, the ex-Deputy Executive of the Kuomintang
He was escorted by three Chinese detectives of the French Police.

Dr. Ho Ping Soong (何炳松) President of the Chinan University.

Mr. T.K. Ho Deputy Secretary of the S.M.C.

Mr. H.C. Chen Chinese Educational Officer of the S.M.C.

Mr. Zau Tsing-ching (趙晉卿)

Mr. Li Shi-mei (S.M.Lee) (李熙謀) Dean of the College of Physics of the Chinan University and Dean of the Middle School Department of the Chinan University, 384 Avenue Foch. He is native of Huchow, age 43; returned student from the U.S.A. where he studied Electrical Engineering. In 1930 he was a member of the Executive Committee of the Sino-Polish Cultural Association.

报告
日期：1939年8月26日

事由：中波文化协会——为波兰公使举行的告别晚宴

由 D.S.I. Prokofiev 撰写。由 C. Crawford S.I. 转呈。

（批注：Z.P. Liu，情报，R.D. Yake，A.Y. 26/8。）

1939年8月25日晚8时至11时之间，在中波文化协会的主持下，于国际饭店烧烤厅（Grill Room）举行了一场私人晚宴，以欢送即将不久后返回波兰的波兰驻中华民国特命全权公使乔治·巴特尔·德·韦登塔尔先生（Mr. Georges Barthel de Weydenthal）。出席者约四十人，男女皆有，其中包括波兰公使馆和领事馆的数名成员，以及以下代表教育和商业界的知名华人：

褚民谊博士，国民党中央执行委员会委员，中法工学院院长，地址：拉斐特路1195号；系前国民党执行部副部长汪精卫先生之妹夫。
他由三名法国警察局的华籍侦探陪同。

何炳松博士，暨南大学校长。

T.K. Ho 先生，工部局副秘书。

H.C. Chen 先生，工部局华务教育处处长。

赵晋卿先生（Zau Tsing-ching）。

李熙谋先生（S.M. Lee），暨南大学理学院院长兼暨南大学中学部主任，地址：福煦路384号。籍贯湖州，年龄43岁；留美归国学生，在美国攻读电机工程。1930年曾任中波文化协会执行委员会委员。

D.S.I. Prokofiev 和 D.I. Pan Lien-pih 执行了
